query: Here, we have demonstrated that Herpes Simplex Virus type one accumulates Pol II in replication compartments because the virus' unusually accessible DNA genome provides many potential nonspecific binding sites, acting as a molecular sink which causes a net accumulation of Pol II even in the absence of transcription.
